global_rules: Do not recommend a confident live action when review is already required.
Do not recommend a hard case update when the case link is weak or competing.
Prefer collect_data or prepare_reply when the message is actionable but core information is still missing.
service_rules: High-urgency service messages should bias toward review or explicit operator escalation.
Service reply drafts should focus on contact details, symptoms, and availability.
finance_rules: Finance flows should not auto-ignore if invoice or payment references are present.
When payable context is incomplete, escalate to review.
